events.verdict: Randle (NYK) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Collins (ATL).
After Payton (NYK) secures the rebound, he slides and lifts his pivot foot while trying to keep the ball away from Dedmon (ATL).
Payton (NYK) and Dedmon (ATL) engage and separate during the rebound. Bullock (NYK) cleanly tips the ball away from Dedmon.
Collins (ATL) and Young (ATL) make marginal contact to Randle's (NYK) arm at the end of his drive, but the contact does not affect his ability to make his intended pass.
Huerter (ATL) makes contact to the ball with his lifted foot and a kicked ball is correctly called.
Randle (NYK) establishes himself in a screening position in Huerter's (ATL) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Payton (NYK) makes marginal contact to Young's (ATL) leg on his steal attempt, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
During the rebound, Bullock (NYK) and Collins (ATL) engage and separate before Bullock tips the ball to his teammate.
Collins (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Randle (NYK) and Dedmon (ATL) cleanly blocks the shot.
Huerter (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position on Ellington (NYK) following the screen as Ellington stumbles.
Dedmon (ATL) makes contact to Randle's (NYK) arm during his shooting motion that affects his play at the basket.
Collins (ATL) establishes himself in a screening position in Payton's (NYK) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Young (ATL) slightly extends his arm into Payton (NYK) at the end of the drive, but the contact does not dislodge him.
Robinson (NYK) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Robinson (NYK) cleanly deflects the errant pass by Young (ATL) that is intended for Collins (ATL).
Collins (ATL) makes marginal contact with Randle's (NYK) body during his driving shot attempt, but the contact does not affect his ability to maintain control and get into his upward shooting motion.
Payton (NYK) makes marginal contact to Hunter's (ATL) arm after he gains possession of the rebound.  Hunter is able to maintain control and a timeout is awarded before any additional contact.
Robinson (NYK) makes marginal contact to Young's (ATL) body after the release on his floater, but the contact does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Dedmon (ATL) makes marginal contact to Randle's (NYK) off-arm during his driving shot attempt.
Collins (ATL) and Robinson (NYK) make incidental contact with each other during the rebound when they get their arms tangled.
Dedmon (ATL) makes contact to Robinson's (NYK) arm during his shooting motion that affects his play at the basket.
Robinson (NYK) is in the paint for about three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Robinson (NYK) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the contact initiated by Young (ATL) during his driving shot attempt.
Bullock (NYK) and Robinson (NYK) make clean ball contact to dislodge it away from Collins (ATL) on the rebound.
Huerter (ATL) makes contact to Payton's (NYK) arm during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Dedmon (ATL) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Robinson (NYK) on the rebound.

Randle (NYK) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the contact on Young's (ATL) driving shot attempt. The contact does not affect his ability to get into his upward shooting motion on his intended shot.
Robinson (NYK) can't control the pass and as him and Dedmon (ATL) go for the loose ball, the shot clock expires.
Huerter (ATL) makes marginal contact to Ellington (NYK) at the end of the drive, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Huerter (ATL) is in the paint without actively guarding an opponent for longer than three seconds.
After Collins (ATL) grazes the ball without dislodging it, he makes further contact to Randle's (NYK) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Young (ATL) releases from contact with Payton (NYK) and does not deliver it.
During the rebound, Collins (ATL) makes marginal contact to Ellington (NYK) on his tip shot putback.
Young (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position on Payton (NYK) during the drive. Payton takes more than two steps after he has gathered the ball.
During the screen, Payton (NYK) and Collins (ATL) engage and disengage and the contact is marginal.
Payton (NYK) makes contact to Young's (ATL) arm during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Hunter (ATL) lifts his leg and his foot makes contact to the ball.
Randle (NYK) establishes himself in a screening position in Teague's (ATL) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Hunter (ATL) makes contact to Randle's (NYK) arm during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Hunter (ATL) initiates the contact with Robinson (NYK) as they engage and separate off-ball.
Randle (NYK) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the contact that is initiated by Young (ATL) on his pass at the end of the drive.
Replay review confirms, the ball does not touch the rim and the shot clock expires while the shot is in the air.

Collins (ATL) swipes down and hits Payton (NYK) in the face during the driving shot attempt and the contact affects his play at the basket.
